mechanism_narrative: The sustained and accelerating decline in RETAIL_REC mobility over the past four weeks indicates a worsening trend in discretionary activity, which will continue to depress retail and recreation visits over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A significant week-on-week increase in RESIDENTIAL mobility, indicating stricter stay-at-home orders or heightened public adherence, will directly lead to a further reduction in RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises by more than 5 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decrease over the next two weeks despite RESIDENTIAL mobility rising by more than 5 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: The concurrent and significant decline in both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT mobility reflects a broad reduction in commuting and general movement, which will continue to suppress retail and recreation activity over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days while both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain at or below their current low levels.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of tightening restrictions, the sharp and accelerating decline in PARKS mobility signals a broader public retreat from outdoor discretionary activities, which will extend to and further reduce RETAIL_REC over the next week.
failure_condition: PARKS mobility remains low or declines further, but RETAIL_REC shows an increase over the next 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM mobility drops below baseline and continues its decline, it indicates a heightened public caution or stricter essential-only movement, which will negatively impact RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below 0% and continues to decline week-on-week
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM remains low or declines further, but RETAIL_REC stabilizes or increases over the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The widespread and accelerating decline across all non-residential mobility categories (RETAIL_REC, GROCERY_PHARM, PARKS, TRANSIT, WORKPLACES) indicates a strong public adherence to stay-at-home directives, which will continue to suppress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: A significant rebound in any of the non-residential categories occurs, leading to an increase in RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The combined effect of a sharp decline in WORKPLACES mobility and a significant increase in RESIDENTIAL mobility indicates a strong shift towards remote work and stay-at-home, directly reducing opportunities for retail and recreation visits over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES remains low and RESIDENTIAL remains high, but RETAIL_REC shows an unexpected recovery over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Given the current severe decline in TRANSIT mobility, any further significant drop below -50% would indicate even stricter travel restrictions or public avoidance, further depressing RETAIL_REC over the next week.
failure_condition: TRANSIT drops below -50%, but RETAIL_REC does not decline further or even increases over the next 7 days.
